guarantees.claim: out_buf is net-assigned to u_prim_buf_out.out_o, passing the signal from out via the buffer instance.
The prim_buf instance is configured with Width = NumOutBufBits.

assumptions.claim: NumOutBufBits must equal the bit-width of both out and out_buf to avoid data truncation or extension.
assumptions.cond: When the instance is used and both signals are active
assumptions.risk: Mismatched width would cause truncation or zero-extension, corrupting AES output data.

uncertain_points.claim: The prim_buf module may have unconnected inputs (e.g., enable, reset) that are required for correct operation; if left floating, out_buf may be undriven or hold stale values.
uncertain_points.cond: Depends on the actual port list of prim_buf
uncertain_points.risk: Data corruption or indeterminate output on out_buf, breaking AES ciphertext integrity.

uncertain_points.claim: Parameter NumOutBufBits may be set inconsistently with the declared widths of out and out_buf elsewhere in the design.
uncertain_points.cond: If the parameter value is not cross-checked during elaboration
uncertain_points.risk: Silent data truncation or extension, leading to functional failure or security weakness in AES output.
